sources.title: FFW_SG2 Raw HDF5 Demo Hub - Physical AI Dataset | Claru
sources.snippet: Repository of raw HDF5 demonstrations from ROBOTIS FFW_SG2 humanoid recorded and augmented in Isaac Sim/Isaac Lab. Serves as a storage and data transformation pipeline for imitation learning, not for direct training.

sources.title: FFW SG2 Rev1 PickCoke2 TsFile - Physical AI Dataset | Claru
sources.snippet: Why This Matters for Physical AI This dataset provides structured time-series manipulation data with synchronized robot state and action observations for training physical AI models on pick-and-place tasks.
